# Hanji

Hanji is an independent experimental lab exploring collaboration between people and agents. Its two current projects share an AGPL-3.0-only codebase. The unified Hanji agent identity is an ambition, not a shipped runtime.

## Projects
- [Knowledge](https://hanji.ink/projects/knowledge/): A git-backed Markdown knowledge base, scoped MCP access, and human-reviewed agent proposals.
  - [Knowledge handbook](https://gethanji.github.io/docs/): Knowledge documentation, published separately. Tracker has no handbook yet.
- [Tracker](https://hanji.ink/projects/tracker/): An experimental project tracker with file-backed issues, projects, and comments. Developer builds include Claude and Codex sessions; session state also uses a local database. Live-agent validation and public distribution are not yet complete.

## Languages
- [English](https://hanji.ink/)
- [한국어](https://hanji.ink/ko/lab/)
- [Deutsch](https://hanji.ink/de/lab/)
- [日本語](https://hanji.ink/ja/lab/)
- [Français](https://hanji.ink/fr/lab/)

All three pages are available in the five languages listed above. English project URLs use /projects/{project}/; other languages use /{language}/projects/{project}/. Legacy /en/, /ko/, /de/, /ja/, and /fr/ redirect to the corresponding Knowledge page, preserving query and fragment. Tracker is early development; do not infer a hosted offering or public source availability from these pages.
